outcome: Childhood B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (BCP-ALL)
cohort: 1,126 children (0-12 years) with ALL (78.5% BCP-ALL) and 2,252 age- and sex-matched controls
finding: Cesarean section delivery and being the firstborn child were associated with an increased risk of ALL, particularly in children who were both firstborn and delivered via C-section.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with an increased risk of ALL.
